page: Microsoft Azure NC36lds_xl_RTXPRO6000BSE_v6 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCdsRTXPRO6000BSEv6XL family. It is powered by an Intel processor with an x86_64 architecture, offering 36 dedicated vCPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is configured with 72.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a low-memory allocation of 2.0 GB per core.

This server features a single integrated GPU and includes 1980 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is also premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. The combination of dedicated compute cores, local NVMe storage, and a hardware accelerator provides a balanced platform for workloads requiring parallel processing and fast local data access.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server targets workloads that require GPU acceleration and high compute density without the overhead of a large memory footprint. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it a resource-dense option for GPU-bound tasks. Appropriate workloads include hardware-accelerated rendering, machine learning inference, parallel compute tasks, and graphics-intensive applications that benefit from fast local NVMe storage.
